date_text: Thu, Nov 26th • 12:00 PM AEDT - Sun, Nov 29th • 10:00 PM AEDT
description: It’s back! A beloved Sweeney’s tradition returns as Bridge Road Brewers take over all the taps across all four floors of the pub. This year they’re rolling in with a massive 34 different beer stars, poured side by side from the rooftop to the ground floor. Expect everything from the return of Chestnut Pilsner, right through to the legendary B2 Bomber, Edition 16. Whether you’re chasing something crisp, dark, hoppy, big, weird, or wonderful — there’s truly something for everyone. Taplist:- - B2 Bomber 16 - Nitro POG Sour - Nitro Genovese Coffee Stout - Beechworth Pale Ale - Outside Lager - XPA - Bling IPA - Little Bling - Fat Man Red Suit Big Sack - Little Hazy - Pale Mid - Hefe EBV - Yuzu & Tangerine IPA - Trip Hop Hazy Pale - Superdelic Cali IPA - Sunshine Bliss Sour - Ginger Beer - Strata IPA - Saison - Village Pils - Daves Red - Pro-Am Beer - Plush IPA - Hive Shaker Wit - Unicorn Vanilla Ice Cream Ale - Fasteners Swill Bock - Hat Trick Hazy IPA - Dark Side of Tasman NZ IPA - Helles Lager - Hard Cola - Marzen - Chestnut Pilsner - Robust Porter (HAND PUMP) - Celtic Red (HANDPUMP)
